task: Stopgap for #217: pin the Air-Gap E2E job's runner to ubuntu-24.04 because ubuntu-latest rolled to ubuntu-26.04 and broke all three filesystem jobs on the runner image. Workflow runs-on line plus a decision comment only.

events.summary: Only `runs-on` of the e2e-airgap job changed (ubuntu-latest -> ubuntu-24.04) plus a D1 comment. Not touched: E2E scripts, manifests, agent code, chart, other workflows (ci.yaml / release.yaml still on ubuntu-latest; risk recorded in #217).

Reproduced from GitHub Actions history: scheduled E2E run 39221341848 (2026-10-19, runner image ubuntu-24.04) succeeded for xfs/ext4/btrfs; runs 40290897461 (2026-10-26) and 41427109519 (2026-11-02), both on image ubuntu-26.04 with no E2E-related repo change in between, failed all three. 41427109519 log: `ctr: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = content digest sha256:71b0cbca... not found` during `kind load docker-image` (xfs/btrfs); ext4 lacks linux-modules-extra for the 26.04 kernel.
Pinned the e2e-airgap job to ubuntu-24.04, the last image the suite passed on, with a decision comment naming the cost and the escape hatch (#217).
The PR's own pull_request-triggered Air-Gap E2E run executes all three filesystem jobs on the pinned image; this trace is only claimed passed once that run is green (checked before merge).
events.scope: CI-runner level: proves the existing E2E passes again on ubuntu-24.04. It does not make the suite work on ubuntu-26.04 (tracked in #217) and adds no new quota enforcement evidence beyond what the E2E already asserts.

events.summary: Air-Gap E2E runs on ubuntu-24.04 again; the 26.04 incompatibility is tracked in #217.
Stopgap pin applied; real 26.04 fix deferred to #217.
